site_descricao: Polpad: an open source ESP32-C3 macropad. Download the software, firmware and hardware, and browse community projects.
comunidade_intro: Cases, profiles, builds and firmware made by Polpad users. Every project is reviewed before it goes in.
comunidade_vazio: No projects of this type yet.
projeto_sem_arquivos: This project has no files to download yet.
baixar_intro: Everything you need to build and use the Polpad. Files always come from the latest version on GitHub.
baixar_software_texto: The app sets up the keys, the encoder and the display, and updates the macropad firmware.
baixar_firmware_texto: You do not need to download the firmware: the app flashes and updates the macropad by itself, over USB.
baixar_hardware_texto: The two-piece 3D case. Schematic and board (PCB) coming soon.
